reviews.title: Best rehab app
reviews.text: This is the best app out there. If I could give it 100 stars i would. I was using it instead of paying $300 at the physical therapist for. Is $299 for a whole year but the price is totally 100% worth it. You go at your own pace. You have guided videos and the workouts are actually effective at rehab rehabilitation. I have areas of pain everywhere and I have been using this app every single day. Great exercises. I 100% recommend this program.

reviews.title: Awesome Rehab Tool
reviews.text: This app is fantastic for rehabbing those nagging injuries.  Been using it for a couple months, and my pain has decreased significantly.

reviews.title: Wealth of Library Content
reviews.text: This is quite a bit of good content and programs beyond what my PT prescribed and I’m glad following this for my shoulder recovery. The programs are extensive and target each area. I’m using this for warming up and injury prevention as well. On my road to recovery…

reviews.title: Quality content

reviews.title: Refund not possible
reviews.text: I was trying to cancel my subscription and get a refund as per their 30 day guarantee. It’s not true. When I was trying to get a refund, if you are using your Iphone to subscribe to the app, they are not able to help you. No refunds. Apple did not honor the 30 day guarantee either. Such a shame. reviews.title: Clear progress
reviews.text: I am 4 weeks in on the back rehab program and I’m starting to see improvement. I really like that there is a class option where you follow a video or an exercise option once you know what to do. I’m excited to progress to a Prehab program after this and build back up to fitness.

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: This has been a godsend - I’ve been able to do quality PT on a severe low back injury from my home, which greatly increases my ability to stick to this plan. The pain relief I’ve already experienced with the low back rehab in week 4 is tremendous. Looking forward to the Prehab one!

reviews.title: Easy to Navigate
reviews.text:
I’ve only gone through a couple of sessions but I find the app very easy to navigate which is actually a big thing for me. Anything that removes friction & helps me complete my rehab exercises reinforces consistency which is what will produce results. The exercises seem solid as well. I also really like how there is a class mode that explains everything & an exercise mode that just hits your programs exercises to save time once you know what to expect. This mode automatically starts timers & progresses from exercise to exercise. I find it to be another way the app assists me with compliance. 

I’ll note that my chiropractor was able to provide me with a letter of medical necessity which allowed me to use HSA funds for my initial purchase. If you don’t have a provider but want to use FSA/HSA, Prehab guys partnered with Truemed where you can get an LMN for a nominal cost. As I understand it, they review your case to ensure legitimacy & then process the LMN for you. It’s work it if you have funds to use but be aware, you may also be able to get one from your own provider.

reviews.title: Unique Approach to (P)Rehab Outside of Doctor’s Office
reviews.text: After hip labral repair surgery, I’ve had some unexpected effects due to compensation, including feet and ankle issues. I just started both the hip and foot/ankle rehab programs, and I know I did the right thing getting this app. It’s not always convenient to PT in person due to the amount of time spent, but allowing me to customize how much time I can spend and how often makes recovery more attainable. I am love the idea also that once I progress, I can “Prehab” to ensure I’m doing what I can to keep mobile and prevent injury.

reviews.title: Absolutely love & worth every penny
reviews.text:
You can’t find this assistance or guidance across so many different levels of need or the variety of options at which to pursue them. 
I’ve been lifting weights for 15 years now & Im a dental hygienist who has to constantly contort herself to meet the demands of the patient & job. I teach yoga regularly but this has helped me truly feel confident in living my life! I can come home to quadruplet 2 yr olds & throw them around after treating a patient with a spinal fusion who couldn’t rotate & be fearless about what I might tweak. 
Thank you Prehab Guys (& now I see some chicks 🫶🏼) long time follower 🙏

reviews.title: Feels like a scam - no way to cancel
reviews.text:
I signed up for a free 7 day trial from their Instagram page with my credit card info. Downloaded the app, but it says my trial is not active and that I would need to pay for another subscription once again.

In the meantime, I’ve received an email saying that I’m going to be charged $200 unless I cancel before my trial is up. But there is no way to cancel from the app, and I’ve sent three emails over the 3 days to get help, but no one has responded yet.

reviews.title: It’s so close to borderline perfect, but it’s still great.
reviews.text:
2 things holding me back from 5 stars, and 2 things only:

1. A cleaner way to track progress / see what you did in the past for weights / reps / band color etc within programs.

2. Having some app stability challenges that cause me to have to force restart sessions. Not a big deal, but it’s happening slightly more frequently 

3. This one doesn’t prevent 5 stars at all, but it would be cool to be able to say “I’m doing upper performance level one. Lower performance level 1 and core performance across a 6 day a week split.  And have it populate the sessions for me.

I recognize I’m asking for more “fitness app” stuff, than rehab stuff, but the programming is so good I use it for both.

reviews.title: App needs work
reviews.text:
It is great that I can get structured physical therapy programs that I can do at home! The exercises are great! However the app needs a lot of work 
- it quits running programs while running in the background
- some educational videos take forever to load or never load
- some of the exercises have the incorrect number of sets or incorrect timing when “playing through a program”
- there’s a lot of the app that I don’t understand — it seems like there are a few different “sections” of the app that don’t talk to each other well.

reviews.title: Pattern of Deceptive Free Trial Presentation - Multiple Users Affected
reviews.text:
I was charged $49 within days of signing up after seeing “Start Your 7-Day Free Trial” prominently displayed at the top of the app. The pricing screen shows the monthly plan ($49) clearly states “Does Not Include FREE Trial,” yet the app’s main screen and hero section heavily advertise a 7-day free trial without clearly distinguishing that it only applies to the annual plan.
When I contacted support about the unexpected charge, they directed me to the website. However, the in-app presentation is what drove my decision to sign up. The annual plan button does say “Start My Free Trial,” but the prominent banner at the top of the entire app simply says “Start Your 7-Day Free Trial”—with no mention of plan restrictions.  

This isn’t an isolated misunderstanding. Multiple users on the App Store show the same pattern: we see ‘Start Your 7-Day Free Trial’ prominently displayed, select what we think is that offer, and are charged immediately. The developer acknowledges this confusion in their responses but hasn’t fixed it. The app is systematically misleading users about when the free trial applies

reviews.title: Deceptive
reviews.text:
In case someone out there is thinking about getting this app, double check. I was looking to try the app put as you need a subscription to surf around. They market a 7-day free trial, however it is not for any subscription. I got the one month subscription thinking I had a 7-day free trial but the charged me right away. No trial, no chance to explore the app, just a quick money grab. You won't get a refund from apple and no the wording isn't clear. It is marketed as an app meant to help people but it's a money grab instead.

Onto the app, it's clunky and not as smooth to use. The plans are cookie cutters and not really personalized to you. You can target areas but you can't target specific issues. These aren't personalized plans as they market it. Which is the only reason I wanted to check out the app before a purchase. Developers did an ok job, but they have this no refund set because they know it's not a well developed app.  No hard feelings, just the truth. Enjoy my $50 😁

reviews.title: AMAZING app, but occasionally bugs are frustrating!
reviews.text:
I love love this app, it has helped cure my chronic shoulder pain. However, the occasional bugs will make the app unusable for a few days, and that’s frustrating given how much I rely on this app for my day to day fitness. 

Two bugs that occur: sometimes users cannot sign in. When you go to sign in via email, you enter that and then your password, and it takes you back to the Home Screen. (Yes, I’ve updated the app, deleted it and reinstalled , and restart my phone). 

The second is sometimes when the exercises are running they will freeze, and you have to force quit the app to get it to work again. This is more annoying than anything because you have to click through all the exercises you’ve already done to get to the proper place. However, this is less annoying than the first bug that renders the app unusable. 

Even with the bugs I still recommend this app highly, but just know to expect that.
